People love to tell me that we’re living in the best of all possible times, and in many ways they’re right — I wouldn’t trade my dentist for a medieval one. But I get suspicious when anyone says progress is automatic. Things don’t just get better on their own. Somebody has to fight for clean water, for shorter working hours, for the right to vote. Those things were won, not given. And the same goes for the next set of improvements. If we sit back and assume history is on our side, we’ll wake up to find it has quietly wandered off. So by all means, let’s celebrate how far we’ve come; but let’s also roll up our sleeves.
